Backported upstream fix from commit faba04ef4f2b410257f76c1b9dc85e350929c4b9 in locate_hunk(): do not treat null-range hunks as unconditional matches, preventing infinite search loops on crafted line offsets. Tracker: https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-56289

Backported upstream fix from commit e6d6a4e021660679d7fc9150f981d4920f722313 in another_hunk(): keep chars_read positive when malformed unified-diff hunks carry consecutive end-of-file newline markers. Tracker: https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-56288

The DHI patch builds listed here were published without the backported upstream fix for this CVE that they were intended to carry; their binaries contain the same code as the unpatched upstream 2.8 release, so this CVE should be treated as present in these builds. A corrected DHI rebuild that applies the fix is pending. On Alpine 3.24 a DHI patch build based on upstream 2.8.1, which contains the fix, is published. Upstream fix: https://git.savannah.gnu.org/cgit/patch.git/commit/?id=faba04ef4f2b410257f76c1b9dc85e350929c4b9. Tracker: https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-56289
